body.cap: FutureSense CEO Dami An (left) introduces ‘Food4Chain’ to AVING News reporter Jay Kennedy Marcus at Pre-CES2025 in Incheon (IFEZ). | Photo by AVING News

body.x: FutureSense Co., Ltd. (CEO Dami An) participated in the ‘Pre-CES2025 Incheon (IFEZ)’ held on November 13 at the Grand Ballroom C of Songdo Convensia.

FutureSense provides the cloud-based Food4Chain platform, designed for food manufacturers and global food supply chains. Food4Chain leverages AI and big data to collect and analyze information, securely storing critical business data on a blockchain. The company aims to promote digital transformation (DX) in the food industry, creating a safe, reliable, and sustainable food ecosystem.
FutureSense plans to highlight its blockchain-based solution, Food4Chain, at CES 2025 in Las Vegas and its ability to address the increasingly stringent global food regulations.

Food4Chain offers a Traceability Service that addresses food traceability regulations from authorities like the FDA and the EU. This service updates the latest FDA regulations and facilitates the management of required supply chain data. Powered by blockchain-based Chain-of-Custody technology, it ensures transparency and trust in food supply chain data tracking and management.

It also offers the Inventory and Loss Rate Management Service, which enables real-time production data collection through mobile devices. This service provides factory KPIs for executive decision-making and allows effective responses to issues through batch-level histories.

FutureSense targets buyers, manufacturers, and distributors involved in agri-food exports to the U.S. It focuses on clients using SAP ERP solutions. The company expects Food4Chain to be a powerful integration tool for SAP partners, helping clients meet the USA FDA’s stringent compliance requirements.

body.cap: FutureSense booth at Pre-CES2025 in Incheon (IFEZ). | Photo by AVING News

body.x: To highlight the rising popularity of K-Food, FutureSense is organizing an interactive experience where participants can create instant K-Food menus and explore real-time blockchain-based food traceability systems. This initiative aims to showcase the reliability of K-Food manufacturing and food traceability systems to global distributors, manufacturers, and consumers.

FutureSense collaborates with major franchise groups and the Incheon Food Manufacturing Association, representing 1,200 food manufacturers, to enhance K-Food’s export competitiveness. In October 2023, it signed an MOU with a Chinese SAP Gold Partner to track the food supply chain for global franchises. The company has also secured MOUs with eight companies across five countries, including Europe and Asia, to expand its platform API and SaaS-based business operations.

Following its product launch in 2024, FutureSense has initiated collaboration discussions with major U.S.-based K-Food importers. The company is upgrading its blockchain-based food traceability service to help clients comply with U.S., EU, Middle East, and Asia FDA regulations. FutureSense also plans to develop solutions to address European food regulations, supported by the European Science and Technology Innovation Fund.

A FutureSense representative stated, “Our Food4Chain platform is growing as a blockchain and AI-powered solution for managing global food traceability supply chain data and improving the efficiency of food manufacturing and distribution processes.”

Organized by the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority (IFEZA) and Incheon Technopark, ‘Pre-CES2025 IFEZ’ is part of the ‘Global Top 10 City Incheon Week’ held in the third week of November. Integrating five related events, the event focuses on key themes like healthcare, bio, and smart cities. On November 13, the IFEZ Smart City Tech Conference and the CES2025 Incheon Pavilion showcase occurred concurrently.
